messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a ~20pp drop in prefix cache hit-rate after yesterday's kernel selection tweak on the 40s fleet. Profiling attached in thread.
kevin: ugh. which tweak exactly? the int8 kernel change?
sasha: we switched kernel v2 -> v2.1 that shuffles matmul tiling for longer context, plus a batching heuristic change (aggressive mergeThreshold).
junaid: numbers?
maria: baseline (before): 93.8% prefix hit on steady state for chat workloads. after deploy: 73.1%. P95 latency up ~18ms and per-token GPU time up 12%.
perf-bot: [perf-report] 1719904400: generated flamegraphs and KV hit traces: /internal/perf/1719904400
kevin: interesting — the KV hittrace shows many cache key mismatches are off by whitespace + tool-field order. but the suddenness smells like kernel-induced tokenization divergence too.
sasha: kernel change shouldn't affect tokenizer, but batching heuristics change can alter chunking which exposed a latent key non-determinism when callers send tool calls in varying orders.
maria: confirmed: 40% of misses are identical text except function/tool metadata ordering. Another 30% have token offsets differing by 1 (likely tokenizer version pin mismatch).
junaid: (typo) meant junaid: Can we map miss buckets? e.g., whitespace vs tokenizer vs tool-field?
maria: did that. bucket breakdown: 42% tool-field-order, 33% token-seq-shift, 15% canonical-whitespace, 10% other (system prompt deltas).
kevin: proposed fixes: 1) canonicalize tool/function key ordering at API ingress 2) include tokenizer-version tag in cache key 3) add a lightweight key-version migration so old-prefixed keys still match via alternate lookup 4) revert aggressive mergeThreshold until warmup.
sasha: agree on (1) and (2). for (3) we need to ensure lookup cost is bounded. if we try alternate probes per request we can blow up tail latency. maybe probe only on miss and mark session with resolved key-version.
maria: implementation sketch for alternate-lookup (only on miss):
```
key_v = compute_key(body, metadata, key_schema_v2)
if cache.get(key_v): return value
else:
    alt_key = compute_key(body, metadata, key_schema_v1)
    v = cache.get(alt_key)
    if v: // migrate asynchronously
        async cache.set(key_v, v)
        mark_session_tokenizer(session_id, key_schema_v2)
        return v
    else:
        generate_and_write_new_key(key_v)
```

kevin: that probing plan seems reasonable. keep it async-copy to avoid holding locks. also recording which sessions saw probing helps us prewarm.
junaid: about tokenizer version pinning: our SDKs sometimes default to latest tokenizer from the model repo. we should make model-serving pin explicit in the model manifest and bake it into the key. backward compatible behavior when we roll tokenizers should be documented.
sasha: agree. add a model-manifest field tokenizer_hash and include it in key canonicalization.
maria: warmup strategy: we should run a targeted warmup job that hits top 2000 active prefixes per region after the fix deploy. For Dedicated clusters, coordinate with autoscaler to run at low-traffic windows.
kevin: can we cross-check which kernels altered sequence-length alignment causing token offset? maybe tiling changed how we chunk and that interacts with prior prefix-normalization that trimmed trailing spaces.
sasha: yes — I ran a short profile: kernel v2.1 relabels chunk boundaries for sequences >=1024 so final tokenization differs for inputs near tile boundaries. that explains token offset bucket.
maria: action items: 1) kevin - add canonical tool-field ordering in ingress + tests (ETA 1d) 2) junaid - add tokenizer_hash into model manifest and compute_key (ETA 2d) 3) sasha - roll back mergeThreshold and patch kernel metric gating so we can A/B test (ETA today) 4) maria - schedule warmup job and prefill migration probe list (ETA 48h) 5) infra - throttle probing to 1% rollouts to limit tail latency (cc infra).
kevin: test cases to cover: permutations of tool arg order, varied whitespace, + explicit tokenizer version mismatch simulation. I’ll add to the regression suite.
junaid: note — do not rely on full-text normalization that strips meaningful whitespace (code blocks). need fine-grained canonicalization: remove insignificant whitespace between structured tool metadata only.
maria: agreed. we'll add a canonicalizer that is rules-based for tool fields and a conservative whitespace normalizer with a flag for 'code_preserve'.
sasha: quick rollback plan: revert mergeThreshold + restore kernel v2 on the fleet via staged deploy. run smoke to confirm hit-rate returns.
maria: perf-bot: run hit-rate audit for last 72h and post diff after the fixes land.
perf-bot: acknowledged. audit queued: /internal/perf/audits/1719904321-fix-run
kevin: one more thought — consider adding a short-lived 'compat-mode' header for SDKs that upgrades clients to new key-schema lazily. could make migration smoother.
junaid: SDK change might be bigger lift; prefer server-side compatibility first.
maria: ok moving forward with server compatibility + SDK guidance. i'll update the runbook and create a short internal note for CS to expect potential transient misses for customers on Dedicated.
kevin: thx all. I'll start the ingress change PR now.
sasha: I’ll open the kernel gating patch and coordinate rollback run.
maria: I'll draft the warmup job config and share the prefill list.
junaid: will update manifest schema and SDK docs.
kevin: ping when PRs are up, we can merge in sequence with infra gates. :thumbsup:
